message.content:
I kept the same efficient vector copy construction and added an `optimize("O3")` attribute so GCC can apply more aggressive inlining/scheduling to this hot copy constructor.

```cpp
__attribute__((optimize("O3")))
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
